wish: someone should make an app that takes one picture a day facing south at solar noon and makes a time-lapse
spec:
Shows today's solar noon from your longitude (or location, or time zone as an estimate).
Tap start camera, face south, take the day's photo; the previous day shows as a faint ghost for alignment.
Plays saved days back as a time-lapse. Frames stay on the device; no reminders or cloud backup.
notes: Solar noon is computed offline from longitude with an equation-of-time approximation. Photos stored in localStorage at 480px max; oldest dropped if storage fills.
